phase_name: Redeploy, sweep all five repositories, and close the acceptance criteria

objectives.description: Run deploy-headless.sh against this repository first, then each out-of-tree target, for all five repositories
objectives.note: 4/5 landed_verify_clean; sf1-engine landed_verify_red on an unrelated pre-existing finding in a non-deploy snapshot directory (integration/claude-system/).

objectives.description: Run verify-sapience-mcp.sh in each redeployed repository and record every check's verdict beside its Phase 1 baseline
Run the tagged-write reachability probe end to end in each repository (dry-run only)
Record the capture/activation verdict per repository and restate the active-but-not-captured set
Append the four per-goal disposition blocks to the records file
Set a non-blocking user_decision on .return-meta.json (mirrored to .orchestrator-handoff.json)
Record one result line per repository and a win/issue entry via issue-record.sh
objectives.note: No exclusions. One win entry (sweep success) and one issue entry (sf1-engine pre-existing finding) recorded.

deviations.description: sf1-engine's deploy-headless.sh run reported RESULT=landed_verify_red due to a pre-existing task-reference finding in a git-committed, out-of-scope snapshot directory (integration/claude-system/) unrelated to the live .claude/ deploy tree or this task's sapience-extension work.
deviations.reason: Per the plan's own Rollback/Contingency guidance (record and report rather than weaken a check to force green), the finding was recorded via issue-record.sh and reported in the records file rather than fixed; the sapience-specific verification (check (j), check (e), the dry-run probe) for sf1-engine was independently confirmed green and unaffected by this unrelated finding.
